entities.name: MCM7
observations: High MCM7 immunohistochemical expression (labeling index ≥76%) was associated with significantly worse recurrence-free survival in patients with Dukes C colorectal cancer after curative surgery.
The available abstract does not report the numerical hazard ratio or p value and does not establish whether MCM7 remained independent in multivariable analysis.

entities.name: Dukes C colorectal cancer
observations: In a 145-patient Japanese surgical cohort with median 87-month follow-up, MCM7-positive tumors had significantly worse recurrence-free survival than MCM7-negative tumors among Dukes C cases.

entities.name: PMID:25075101
observations: Ishibashi et al. reported that MCM7 expression was a risk factor for recurrence in Dukes C colorectal cancer; MCM7 positivity was defined as labeling index ≥76%.
The study also reported significantly worse overall survival in MCM7-positive Dukes C tumors, while no significant OS or RFS difference was observed in Dukes A/B disease.
